entities.name: geared head
entities.relation: precise, separate tilt and level adjustments for straight verticals in interiors

entities.name: ball head
entities.relation: faster but less precise head; harder to level in small steps

entities.name: 3-way head
entities.relation: pan/tilt head with separate axes, common in kits such as the 290 Xtra

entities.name: center column
entities.relation: adds height but adds vibration; a 90-degree column helps in tight rooms

entities.name: HDR bracketing
entities.relation: multiple exposures that must align, so the tripod must not move

entities.name: flambient
entities.relation: flash plus ambient blend that also needs identical frames

entities.name: Arca-Swiss
entities.relation: dovetail plate standard; proprietary plates such as 410PL and RC2 are not compatible

entities.name: bubble level
entities.relation: levels the camera so vertical lines stay straight

entities.name: wide-angle lens
entities.relation: ultra-wide lenses exaggerate any tilt, so leveling matters

entities.name: leg angles
entities.relation: independent leg angles let a leg sit on a stair or counter

entities.name: flip lock
entities.relation: lever leg locks that show at a glance whether they are closed

entities.name: twist lock
entities.relation: leg locks that can pick up grit outdoors

entities.name: Manfrotto
entities.relation: 290, 190 and geared head lines recommended by most ranking pages

entities.name: Benro
entities.relation: Mach3 carbon legs recommended for tall, heavy-duty work

entities.name: carbon fiber
entities.relation: lighter legs that damp vibration better than aluminum
